en: Gary has three episodes now.
The third one argues that you do not have to suffer to succeed.
There are people who believe you must grind, must go through battles, must earn it through pain.
He disagrees, and the episode ends by saying that is his position.
What he noticed while making it is that this series lets him talk about the things he actually cares about.
Buddhism.
Reincarnation.
Abraham Hicks.
Manifestation, eventually, if he wants it.
He can also go the traditional route and talk about specifically Asian things, like whether an adult should still live at home.
The range is enormous, and none of it breaks the format.
zh: 现在已经有三集了。
第三集在讲一个观点：成功不一定要靠吃苦。
有些人相信你必须拼命，必须经历战斗，必须用痛苦换来结果。
他不同意，而那一集的结尾就是在说，这就是他的立场。
他在做这一集的时候发现，这个系列让他可以聊他真正在乎的东西。
佛教。
轮回。
Abraham Hicks 的教导。
如果他想，以后甚至可以直接聊显化。
他也可以走比较传统的路线，聊那些很亚洲的题目，比如成年人该不该还住在家里。
可以涵盖的范围非常大，而且这些都不会破坏这个格式。

en: Almost every other format Gary runs is closed.
A vocabulary word card teaches one word, ends, and the ceiling on it is whether you learned the word.
The whiteboard series explains a difference between two terms and then it is over.
Those formats are complete in themselves, which is exactly why they cannot carry anything else.
The listening test is open.
The passage content is a free variable.
The thing that holds attention is the meter climbing and the score at the end, and that mechanic does not care what the passage is about.
So he can put any idea he has inside it and the retention still works.
That is not a small difference.
It is the difference between a format that produces videos and a format that can carry a body of thought.
zh: 他做的其他格式几乎都是封闭的。
单词卡教一个单词，讲完就结束了，天花板就是你有没有学会那个词。
白板系列解释两个词的差别，然后就没了。
这些格式本身就是完整的，也正因为完整，它们没办法承载别的东西。
听力测验是开放的。
段落的内容是一个自由变量。
真正留住注意力的，是那根往上爬的刻度和最后的分数，而这个机制根本不在乎段落在讲什么。
所以他可以把任何想法放进去，留存率照样成立。
这个差别不小。
这是「一个能产出影片的格式」跟「一个能承载一整套思想的格式」之间的差别。

en: Gary described an intersection: people who want to improve their English, people who respect the IELTS test, and people who like his ideas.
The order matters more than the overlap.
The format recruits broadly, because English learners are an enormous group and a self-scoring test is irresistible to them.
Then the content quietly filters.
Someone who only wanted listening practice gets listening practice and leaves satisfied.
Someone who hears an argument about suffering and success and thinks yes, exactly, that person is no longer an audience member.
They are a follower.
His word card videos recruit broadly and filter for nothing.
Everybody who watches one gets the same thing out of it.
That is why a hundred of them do not compound into anything.
This format compounds, because every episode sorts the room a little further.
zh: Gary 描述了一个交集：想提升英文的人、尊重雅思这个考试的人、还有喜欢他的想法的人。
这里顺序比交集本身更重要。
这个格式先广招人，因为学英文的人基数巨大，而一个可以自己打分的测验对他们来说几乎无法抗拒。
然后内容会安静地做筛选。
只是想练听力的人，练到了听力，满意地离开。
而听到「吃苦与成功」这段论述、心里想著对，就是这样的那个人，他就不再只是观众了。
他变成了追随者。
他的单词卡影片是广招人，但不筛选。
每个看的人拿到的东西都一样。
这就是为什么做一百支也不会累积成什么。
这个格式会累积，因为每一集都在把房间里的人再分一次类。

en: Because there are no subtitles during the passage, the viewer cannot skim.
In a normal talking head video the captions let people read at their own speed, half watching, already scrolling.
Here they have to actually listen, sentence by sentence, or they lose their place on the meter.
That means his ideas land harder in this format than in a video where he simply states them.
He built a mechanism that forces genuine attention on his beliefs, and he built it for a completely different reason.
That is the part worth protecting.
zh: 因为段落播放时没有字幕，观众没办法略读。
在一般的口播影片里，字幕让人可以用自己的速度扫过去，一边看一边已经在滑下一支了。
但在这里，他们必须真的在听，一句一句地听，否则就跟丢了刻度的位置。
这代表他的想法在这个格式里，比他直接讲出来还要更有力。
他做出了一个逼人真正专注在他信念上的机制，而当初做它的理由完全不是这个。
这一点最值得保护。

en: Gary is right that he can film it anywhere.
There is a specific reason, and it is worth naming.
The meter is a graphic overlay, not a set.
Every other format he runs depends on the room.
The whiteboard series needs the whiteboard.
The word cards need the framing and the lighting.
This one needs a face and clean audio, and that is all.
Thailand, a hotel room, outdoors, a car, all fine.
There is a bonus hiding in that.
The sharpest criticism episode one received was that the audio was too clean, too slow, too quiet, with no accent and no background noise.
Filming somewhere real solves the scalability question and the difficulty question at the same time.
A passage recorded in a noisy street is both easier to make and harder to understand.
zh: Gary 说他在哪里都能拍，这是对的。
而且有一个很具体的原因值得讲清楚。
那根刻度是一个图层，不是一个场景。
他其他每一个格式都依赖那个房间。
白板系列需要白板。
单词卡需要那个构图和灯光。
这一个只需要一张脸和干净的声音，就这样而已。
泰国、饭店房间、户外、车上，都可以。
这里面还藏了一个红利。
第一集收到最尖锐的批评，就是声音太干净、语速太慢、太安静、没有口音、也没有背景噪音。
跑到真实环境去拍，等于同时解决了规模化的问题和难度的问题。
在吵闹的街上录的一段话，既比较好拍，也比较难听懂。

en: The ideas have to stay inside the test.
The moment an episode becomes a lecture about manifestation with a meter stuck on the side, the format is dead and it is just preaching with a gimmick.
The discipline is that the passage has to work as a genuine listening passage first, and carry the idea second.
Episode two survives this because whether to move out of your parents' house is a real argument that happens to be his.
Episode three survives it because the suffering and grind question is a real argument too.
Manifestation is further out, and it will need more craft to stay in format.
That is a reason to get there slowly, not a reason to avoid it.
zh: 那些想法必须待在测验里面。
一旦某一集变成一堂关于显化的讲课，旁边硬插一根刻度，这个格式就死了，那只是加了噱头的说教。
真正的纪律是：那段话必须先能成立为一段真正的听力材料，其次才是承载观点。
第二集撑得住，因为「要不要搬出去住」本来就是一个真实的争论，只是刚好也是他的立场。
第三集撑得住，因为吃苦与成功同样是一个真实的争论。
显化再往外一点，需要更多功夫才能留在格式里。
这是慢慢走过去的理由，不是回避它的理由。

en: Keep the numbering, keep the cadence, and let the topics get spicier gradually.
Episode three is safely spicy, because plenty of people already disagree with the grind mindset and nobody thinks it is strange for a teacher to have a view on it.
Save the further out material until the tribe has sorted itself over four or five episodes.
The honest description of what this series is: the test is the delivery mechanism for his worldview, and the score is the reason anybody stays for it.
Nobody watches a sixty second monologue about reincarnation from an English teacher.
Everybody watches a test they can score themselves on.
zh: 保持编号，保持节奏，让题目一集一集慢慢变辣。
第三集是安全的辣，因为本来就有很多人不认同那套拼命至上的心态，而且没有人会觉得一个老师对这件事有立场很奇怪。
更外围的题材，等这群人在四五集里自己分完类之后再拿出来。
诚实地描述这个系列到底是什么：测验是他世界观的载体，分数是别人愿意留下来的理由。
没有人会看一个英文老师讲六十秒的轮回。
但每个人都会看一个自己可以打分的测验。
